goal.vi: Đồng ý một phần, phản đối mà không gây mất lòng và cùng tìm cách giải quyết ở giữa.
goal.en: Agree with part of an idea, disagree without hurting anyone and find a middle way.

lines: I think we should move the whole team to the new software next week.
I agree with you that the old system is slow.
That's a fair point. However, a lot of people haven't had any training yet.
I see it a bit differently. Have you thought about how long training takes?
Correct me if I'm wrong, but didn't we try something like this last year?
Maybe we can meet halfway: start with one team and test it.

phrases.say: I agree with you on that.

mean.vi: Nói bạn đồng ý với một ý
mean.en: Say you agree with an idea

why.vi: "Agree" là động từ; không bao giờ nói "I am agree".
why.en: "Agree" is a verb; never say "I am agree".

phrases.say: That's a fair point. However, the cost is still high.
phrases.not: You are wrong because the cost is high.

mean.vi: Ghi nhận ý người khác trước khi phản đối
mean.en: Accept their idea before you disagree

why.vi: Công nhận một phần ý kiến trước khi đưa ra ý khác.
why.en: Accept part of their idea before you disagree.

phrases.say: I see it a bit differently.

mean.vi: Nói bạn có quan điểm khác một cách nhẹ nhàng
mean.en: Say gently that you have a different view

why.vi: Sau động từ dùng "differently", không dùng "different".

phrases.say: Have you thought about the cost of training?
phrases.not: You don't think about the cost.

mean.vi: Chỉ ra vấn đề bằng một câu hỏi
mean.en: Point out a problem with a question

why.vi: Một câu hỏi nêu vấn đề mà không nghe như chỉ trích.
why.en: A question points out a problem without blaming anyone.

phrases.say: Correct me if I'm wrong, but didn't we try this last year?
phrases.not: You forget, we tried this already.

mean.vi: Nêu một ý mạnh mà vẫn khiêm tốn
mean.en: Make a strong point in a soft way

why.vi: Câu này làm ý kiến mạnh nghe mềm hơn và khiêm tốn.
why.en: This makes a strong point sound softer and less sure.

phrases.say: Let's look at the numbers before we decide.

mean.vi: Đưa cuộc tranh luận về dữ kiện

why.vi: Tập trung vào dữ kiện, không nhắm vào con người.
why.en: Focus on facts, not on people.

phrases.say: Maybe we can meet halfway: start small and test it.
phrases.not: OK, your idea and my idea mix.

mean.vi: Đề xuất giải pháp ở giữa

why.vi: Đưa ra cách ở giữa giúp cả nhóm cùng tiến lên.
why.en: A middle way helps everyone move forward.

ai.name: Nina
ai.persona: confident, quick, but open to good reasons
ai.goal: change all the team's software next week

roleplay.you: Your coworker wants a big change next week. Agree with part of her idea, disagree politely with a reason and suggest a middle way.

turns.a: The old system is too slow. We should change everything next week!
turns.h: I agree with you that it's slow. However, people need training first.

turns.a: Training is easy. Two days, maybe?
turns.h: I see it a bit differently. Have you thought about how long it really takes?

turns.a: But we have to change sometime.
turns.h: True. Correct me if I'm wrong, but didn't we try this last year?
Maybe we can meet halfway: start with one team and test it.

roleplay.end: Okay, let's try one team first. Thanks for keeping it calm!
